title: Gamepad Edge Detection

hints.title: How to toggle a boolean
hints.content: Use the NOT operator: `clawOpen = !clawOpen;` This flips `false` to `true` and `true` to `false`.

hints.title: How to set servo position based on a boolean
hints.content: Use an if/else: `if (clawOpen) { clawServo.setPosition(1.0); } else { clawServo.setPosition(0.0); }` Or use the ternary operator: `clawServo.setPosition(clawOpen ? 1.0 : 0.0);`

hints.title: Why does the servo end up at 1.0?
hints.content: The boolean starts as `false`. Since `gamepad1.a` is `true`, we toggle it: `clawOpen = !false` which gives `true`. Then `clawOpen` is true, so we set the servo to 1.0.

hints.title: Getting the servo from hardware map
hints.content: Use `Servo clawServo = hardwareMap.get(Servo.class, "clawServo");` before `waitForStart()`, just like with motors.
